passwords.note: Sports team name plus a recent year is a predictable pattern, so it's rarer than plain words but still guessable.
Capitalising "Password" and adding the year is how many people satisfy password rules.
A short dictionary word like "anchor" is exactly why so many people picked it.
A short, common first name like "karin" is among the most reused passwords.
"volcom" is a surf-brand name, and short brand words like it get reused everywhere.
